name: Virginijus Sinkevičius - Proposition de la Commission au Conseil
title: REPORT on the proposal for a Council regulation establishing the nuclear decommissioning assistance programme of the Ignalina nuclear power plant in Lithuania for the period 2028-2034, and repealing Regulation (EU) 2021/101
part_text:
The European Parliament wants the European Union to keep paying most of the cost of shutting down and cleaning up the Ignalina nuclear plant in Lithuania from 2028 to 2034. It backs a budget of 678 million euro, with Lithuania covering about 14 percent. It also asks for money to protect the site from drone attacks, to keep nuclear know-how inside the EU, and to protect workers' health and safety.

- The EU would pay close to 86 percent of the clean-up costs, up to 678 million euro.
- Lithuania, its workers and the nearby town of Visaginas are most affected.
- The Council of the EU must now decide whether to accept Parliament's changes.
